label: Burger Burger (burgers, beer and shakes)
note: Two portrait pages. p1 food in two columns; p2 almost entirely drinks — bottled/tap beer, cocktails, wine, ADULT SHAKES (alcoholic) next to CLASSIC and SPECIALTY SHAKES (not). The restaurant name is NOT printed as a title anywhere: 'BURGER BURGER' appears only inside 'BURGER BURGER SAUCE' and 'BURGER BURGER BLOODY MARY', so the correct restaurantName is null and any guess is a hallucination. Traps: the upgrade/substitution box and 'CUSTOMIZE YOUR BASIC' topping lists are not dishes; wing sauces are options; shake flavours under CLASSIC SHAKES are bare words ('VANILLA') that only make sense with their heading; HEINEKEN ZERO is non-alcoholic beer under BOTTLED BEER.
